edition_angle: Addressing the physiological cost of physical disuse on neuroendocrine muscle-bone-brain signaling and brain preservation.

assignments.angle: Structural disembodiment and the disruption of muscle-bone-brain trophic signaling pathways accelerating cognitive aging.
assignments.reason: This study offers a concrete biological and biochemical mechanism (myokine and osteokine pathways like irisin, uncarboxylated osteocalcin, and cathepsin B driving BDNF expression and neurogenesis) connecting systemic physical disuse directly to brain aging.
